# MacroMail

> MacroMail is a free, open-source, self-hostable email tool for AI agents.
> It runs on SQLite. Source: https://github.com/willykeenan/macromail.dev

## Product truth

- Site: https://macromail.dev
- Docs: https://macromail.dev/docs
- Source: https://github.com/willykeenan/macromail.dev
- License: MIT
- Backend: SQLite under MACROMAIL_DATA_DIR
- Auth: account signup/login, then Bearer API keys created on /app/api-keys
- REST: https://macromail.dev/api/v1 (or http://localhost:3000/api/v1 when self-hosted)
- MCP: POST https://macromail.dev/api/mcp (or http://localhost:3000/api/mcp) with Authorization: Bearer mm_live_…
- Outbound: the account owner’s own SMTP credentials, saved in /app/settings. MacroMail never sends from the server owner’s mailbox.
- Mailboxes: on the server’s own mailbox domains only (MACROMAIL_MAILBOX_DOMAINS). Internal delivery between MacroMail mailboxes; mail to or from a mailbox must come from one of your own mailboxes. Internet inbound is not available.
- Gmail / Outlook: optional, read-only, only when the server has OAuth env vars. IMAP is not shipped.
- AI triage and drafts: the user’s own Anthropic key, saved in /app/settings or sent as the x-anthropic-key header. There is no server-wide key.

## Self-host (3 commands)

```
cp .env.example .env
npm ci
npm run dev
```

See /llms-full.txt for REST paths and MCP tools.
